pages.title: HarborLedger original public note
pages.body: Founder hiring note, 2026-11-13. We are opening a Southeast Asia business operations lead role in Singapore. The lead will own customer onboarding operations, build the first regional operating team, and run unit-economics experiments. Reports to the CEO. Regional P&L ownership is a possible progression, not promised on entry. Investment or strategy experience is relevant only with evidence of hands-on implementation. Base salary SGD 180,000–210,000; Singapore work-pass sponsorship supported. Email the founder at careers@harborledger.example with one operating intervention you personally implemented. We have not published a conventional job-board listing.

pages.title: CedarWorks original public note
pages.body: Engineering lead note, 2026-11-13. We have a profitable B2B product and are adding a backend technical lead for a six-person engineering team. Own reliability, PostgreSQL scaling and architecture while continuing hands-on development. Remote from South Korea is supported, and travel is optional. Annual base KRW 110–140 million. Submit a CV and a concise reliability case through https://cedarworks.example/apply/backend. No recent funding announcement. No general management or P&L responsibility.

pages.title: AsterGrid original public note
pages.body: Company announcement, 2026-11-13. Raised a seed round. Hiring a founding field engineer in Singapore to implement real-time device integrations at customer sites. Production embedded C++ and robotics experience required. Frequent on-site work and at least 50% travel. Salary and visa sponsorship are not specified. Contact instructions are in the official application form at https://astergrid.example/apply/field.

pages.title: OrbitSeed original public note
pages.body: Company announcement, 2026-11-13. We raised a seed round to continue research. Our current team is complete and we are not recruiting this quarter. There is no open role or named hiring contact in this announcement.
